changes.title: Democrats avoid a messy fight in Maine, but uncertainty lingers: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

changes.title: In Maine Senate Race, Democrats Go From Chaos to Coronation
changes.summary: Troy Jackson’s emergence as the clear front-runner to replace Graham Platner spares the party some challenges but points to some new ones.

changes.title: Maine Democratic Senate race narrows as candidates rally behind Troy Jackson
changes.summary: The crowded Maine Senate race to replace Graham Platner has narrowed as Democrats rallied around former state Senate President Troy Jackson in the leadup to the party's nominating convention on Saturday.

changes.title: Maine Democrats close in on pick to replace Senate candidate Graham Platner
changes.summary: Maine Democrats appear to be settling on a frontrunner to replace former Senate candidate Graham Platner in a rushed process to take on Republican Sen. Susan Collins.
